title: IPC admin.trust.list params
description: Which page of the allowlist (2.1). `after` is the last peer of the previous page, EXCLUSIVE, and absent for the first; it is a position in the ascending order of the peers' canonical strings, not a row, so a peer revoked since the previous page still names the page that follows it. Pages are read against the live overlay and are not a snapshot: a set between two reads may show or hide a peer across the boundary. architect-cto's ruling of 2026-10-04 (relay message 01a10820-b85d-74e6-bf40-e23b46c77a82). THE ENDPOINT DIMENSION (IPC 3.0, ADR-0067 decision 6, LOCAL-IPC.md §The endpoint dimension): with an `endpoint` the page is one direction of that endpoint's effective set, `direction` naming it; `direction` is required with `endpoint` and refused without it (`InvalidArgument`); the page, the order and the `after` cursor are the operator form's. An `endpoint` outside the grammar is `InvalidArgument`, an id no configured entry holds `EndpointUnknown`; the alias is not accepted.
